modules.name: Resident Registration
modules.description: Lets residents and tenants register with mobile number and OTP and have their flat request approved or rejected.

requirements.title: Register with mobile number and OTP
requirements.description: Resident enters mobile number and OTP to start registration.

requirements.title: Select Project, Building and Flat and enter name
requirements.description: Resident selects Project, Building, Flat and enters their name.

requirements.title: Flag flats that already have an active customer
requirements.description: System checks whether the flat already has an active customer. If so, the request is flagged Flat Already Taken for the Society Manager.

requirements.title: Grant full access and notify on approval
requirements.description: When the request is approved, the resident gets full access and a notification.

requirements.title: Show rejection reason and allow reapplication
requirements.description: When the request is rejected, the reason is shown and the resident can apply again.

requirements.title: Hold request and alert Raghuvir Admin when no Society Manager
requirements.description: If the project has no Society Manager, the request waits and Raghuvir Admin is alerted.

requirements.title: Send reminders and alerts for pending requests
requirements.description: A request pending more than 3 days triggers a reminder to the Society Manager. At 7 days, Raghuvir Admin is alerted.

requirements.title: Link new flat to existing account for registered mobile number
requirements.description: If the mobile number is already registered, the new flat is linked to the same account.

requirements.title: Tenant registration with owner name and rent agreement end date
requirements.description: Tenant registration follows the same steps. The tenant picks Tenant and adds the owner's name and rent agreement end date.

rules.title: Request goes only to the project's Society Manager
rules.description: A registration request is routed only to the Society Manager of the selected project.

rules.title: Tenant approval needs Approve residents permission
rules.description: Tenant registrations are approved by any member who has the Approve residents permission.
